fusions.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
fusions.desc: Presses outward around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and restoring 2 health to you. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles (max 40%).

fusions.name: Turf Toss
fusions.desc: Hurls a clod of turf that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets. When it hits, you and every ally deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Warm Hollow
fusions.desc: Raises a patch of warm grass where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it. Every ally inside 5.5 tiles makes it 11% stronger, to a limit of 4.

fusions.name: Herd Heat
fusions.desc: When you are healed, you regain 2 health a second for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. Every ally within 5.5 tiles makes it 10% stronger, to a limit of 4.
